page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top with page number 98 at left. Heading SECTIO TERTIA, subheading CAPUT PRIMUM, then a list of numbered questions in italic, with run-on lines indented. No margin notes. Digitiser watermark at bottom right, not transcribed.

main_text.head: SECTIO TERTIA.
CAPUT PRIMUM.
main_text.l: 3. 4. Quid sit consuetudo, Et quot eius dem requisita.
8. Cujus sit arbitrari de iniquitate, in foro Soli?
9. Cujus de injustitiâ consuetudinis, in foro Poli?
10. 11. Quot actus requirantur ad introducendam consuetudinem?
12. An id Judicis arbitrio sit relinquendum?
13. An ad introducendam consuetudinem requirantur actus judiciales?
14. 15. 16. 17. 18. 19. Quot anni requirantur ad introducendam consuetudinem?

page.notes: Roman numerals in the list are printed in old style (e.g. "ɪ" forms) and are rendered as Arabic here. Line 2 "introducat" and line 3 "requisita" are split across lines in print; joined here. Word "Scripturam possit" and "adversetur" read from a slightly blurred scan. Some line-end hyphens in print ("intro-", "relinquen-", "con-") are resolved by joining the words.
